Admin routes of the subscribers module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/subscribers

List newsletter subscribers

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `search` in query (string, max length 254, optional).
- `source` in query (string, max length 50, optional).
- `status` in query (`"confirmed"`, `"pending"`, `"unsubscribed"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Subscribers retrieved.

## PATCH /v1/admin/subscribers/{id}

Manually unsubscribe / re-activate a subscriber

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateSubscriberDto](#updatesubscriberdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `404`: Subscriber not found.

## Schemas

### UpdateSubscriberDto

- `unsubscribed` (boolean, required).
